userinfo.description: Configuration block for the OpenID Connect UserInfo endpoint

userinfo.path.description: The URL path for the UserInfo endpoint

userinfo.claims.description: List of claims to include in the UserInfo response by default

userinfo.jwt_response.description: Whether to allow clients to request JWT format instead of JSON for UserInfo responses

userinfo.custom_scopes.description: Whether to allow clients to define custom scopes for additional claims in the UserInfo response
